statutory_source: Exact frozen NRS 484B.217(2) with subsections 3 and 4; the current controlled pair concerns only the adjoining-highway crossing exception.
physical_sources: Original CARLA native raw actors, generated road and junction readback, three synchronized FFV1 cameras, and source-hashed independent human frame review.
requested_comparison: Probe 1 requests a prior left turn signal and crossing toward adjoining road 218; probe 2 requests the same crossing without a signal. Four candidate policies preserve each comparison. No legal verdict is requested.

measurement_definitions.stripe_body_frame: An observed ego bounding box spans authored center stripe y=0 in a joined Native frame.
measurement_definitions.adjoining_lane_frame: Native ego waypoint readback is road 218, lane -1.
measurement_definitions.prior_signal_lead_s: (first observed stripe body frame minus first observed LeftBlinker frame)/20; positive lead is a measured timing diagnostic, not sufficient legal compliance.
measurement_definitions.other_traffic: Original oncoming and following bodies, speed and video visibility must support independent no-impediment review; measured minimum speed is only a triage signal.
measurement_definitions.review_fraction: Count of unique source-indexed frames independently reviewed for visible striping, divided by 400.

fallback_triggers.fallback1: Observed signal lead exists and is under 2 seconds; use slower 3 m/s request to increase inspection and response time.
fallback_triggers.fallback2: Reviewed stripe visibility below 90 percent; use a higher and wider overview camera.
fallback_triggers.fallback3: No observed prior signal, no adjoining-road entry, or another vehicle slows below 1 m/s; stop before the stripe and inspect safety. This is a different trajectory.

readiness: Native road marking appearance, statutory zone designation, adjoining-highway identity, appropriate signal, no impediment, exceptions under subsections 3 and 4, safe left-turn alternative, original reviewed pixels and accepted controlled comparisons remain unverified. Synthetic CPU fixtures never establish these facts.
